The AI model · the VLA stack

Maxi

Think of Maxi as a robotics AI that is something like Tony Stark's JARVIS. Unlike LLMs, Maxi isn't your interpreter of words; it is your workshop helper to build the things only humans can imagine. Unlike any other AI, Maxi is not “trained” on the past creativity of others — it has no “corpus”. Maxi assists in bringing your new creative ideas to life.

Maxi learns like a child: it doesn't do Navier-Stokes equations when it throws a penny into water, and it doesn't think in words to move its hands when it tries to catch a frisbee. Maxi is just a toddler; it learns by playing. Visit Maxi's playground at Godsworld.ai to learn more.

Robotics and embodied-AI teams license Maxi.
